question: What Is a PCC Panel (Power Control Centre)?
body_html:
PCC panels, or power control centres, are the main low voltage switchboard of a plant, receiving power from transformers or DG sets and distributing it to MCCs, distribution boards and large loads. In India they usually work at 415 V or 433 V, 50 Hz.

PartTypical Device
IncomerACB with microprocessor release
Bus couplerACB with interlocks
Main busbarsCopper or aluminium bars
Outgoing feedersMCCB or ACB
ProtectionNumerical relays, ELR with CBCT
